name: FishTunaSmall
concept: The small size of the tuna: the same Meshy generation as fish-tuna, scaled by the clean stage.
prompt: A single bluefin tuna fish, whole, swimming pose seen from the side, thick torpedo shaped body tapering to a narrow tail stalk, crescent shaped tail fin, short sickle shaped dorsal fins, row of small yellow finlets, deep blue-black back, silver white belly. Realistic game prop, no base, no stand, no water, no text, no logos.
texture_prompt: Bluefin tuna: dark steel-blue back, silvery white flanks and belly, yellow finlets, glossy wet skin.
